functional.statement: A session reads one generated file, STATUS.md, to know the state of every task, decision, and recent closure.
Record budgets and record shape are enforced by an executable check that exits non-zero on violation, not by prose.
A task cannot be recorded done without the records the Definition of Done requires: a journal line, satisfied acceptance criteria, and the trace its profile demands.
The harness declares a version and a profile per project, and a project may stay on an older version.
Installing the harness into a repository is one command that leaves the result lint-clean.
Adopters receive pristine specification templates, never this repo own specifications.
An opt-in lean task uses a compact contract and closes with executed check records, observable behavior evidence, residual risk, and the acceptance its task version requires.
Parallel lean work declares separate ownership, integration, and an independent verifier before closure.
The pilot compares paired standard and lean runs across elapsed time, tokens, cost, human review, acceptance, rework, escaped defects, and resource regressions without inventing missing telemetry.
Installing lean is one command and does not change the default standard workflow.
Lean startup context lists active work and pending decisions without completed-task or journal history.
Lean tasks close from the task outcome and executed-check evidence without a journal or trace; standard tasks keep those existing records.
The pilot measures documentation time and provider-reported tokens alongside quality and human review.
Current lean tasks distinguish routine technical closure from product and consequential human acceptance; consequential closure includes independent technical verification.
A lean task assesses resource impact before work and records measured before/after checks for cost-bearing paths.
New lean foundation choices record human acceptance, and deployment choices include a production release policy.
Agents present usable product previews and concise choice summaries while routine implementation records remain agent-owned.

The pilot collects recorded usage from explicitly selected local agent sessions without model calls, associates it with a task, deduplicates responses, and excludes incomplete coverage from task token comparisons.

nonFunctional.statement: Zero runtime and dev dependencies; Node >= 24 built-ins only.
Generation is deterministic: a second run produces no diff.
Scripts work from a repository path containing a space or a symlink.
docs/sdd/ stays within the budget harness.json declares; consolidation beats addition.
The linter reports every violation in one run, never only the first.
The harness works with any coding agent, and with none. No rule, gate, or record depends on one vendor's tooling; vendor layers are optional accelerators that hold no rules.
